search.creative_text:
A little catch-up, a lot of pizza 🍕🤍
Tried Pizza Hut’s new Italian Crust with the gang—light, airy, and no one was waiting for me to finish taking photos 😂 There’s even a challenge hiding under every slice to keep things interesting 👀
We went for the QAR 60 combo: a large Italian Crust pizza, 2 portions of wedges and a 1.25L Pepsi, made for sharing between 3–4 people.
Available until 1 December. Get your friends together and make it a pizza date 🍕
